title: Get a permit for outdoor dining on the footpath
what: Get the council's permit before setting up or running an outdoor eating area on a footpath or other public place.

laws.title: Shire of Donnybrook-Balingup Outdoor Eating Areas Local Law 2013

sources.title: Shire of Donnybrook-Balingup Outdoor Eating Areas Local Law 2013
sources.locator: cl 2.1, as made, Gazette No. 9, 24 Jan 2014
sources.quote: Unless exempt under clause 2.2, a person shall not set up or conduct an outdoor eating area in any public place—

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found.

assessment.summary: Using the footpath for outdoor dining needs the council's permit, with fees and conditions.
